What Is A Pastry Chef / Chocolatier / Confectioner?

A Pastry Chef specialises in the art and science of desserts, pastries, bread, and confectionery. Unlike
savory cooking, pastry demands exactitude — measurements, temperatures, and timing are everything.
Chocolatiers specialise in working with couverture chocolate — crafting bonbons, pralines, sculptures, and
bars. Confectioners create sugar work, candies, marzipan, and nougat.

and manage luxury tea programs for hotels, airlines, and brands. A Tea Taster, often based in estates or
auction houses, evaluates tea commercially for quality grading and pricing.

on café concepts, train teams, source beans directly from farmers, and develop roasting profiles.
